messages:
zoe-sec: Heads-up: CedarCare sent follow-ups for their private deployment questionnaire. They asked for: RBAC change log since onboarding, proof of KMS key rotation in last 90 days, and status on a medium vuln our scanner flagged (CVE-2026-0456). Can we bundle a short package before their 10am call?

ash-custsec: CedarCare specifically wants: 1) CSV of rolebinding diffs; 2) CloudTrail slice showing GenerateDataKey calls tied to tenant ARNs; 3) a signed statement that CMKs are non-exportable; 4) vuln triage timeline and mitigation digest. Delivery must be PGP-encrypted to their SFTP.

ben-eng: For RBAC diff I'll pull snapshots from 2026-02-15 and 2026-03-18 and produce a small CSV with columns namespace, subject, role, change. Will remove PII.

harper-ops: KMS export plan: use CloudTrail lookup-events filtered by EventSource=kms.amazonaws.com and then jq to select GenerateDataKey. Example:

```bash
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventSource,AttributeValue=kms.amazonaws.com --start-time 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z --end-time 2026-03-18T23:59:59Z > /tmp/cedar-kms.json
jq '.Events[] | select(.EventName=="GenerateDataKey")' /tmp/cedar-kms.json > /tmp/cedar-genkey.json
```

ivan-sre: CVE-2026-0456 was in onboarder v2.0.5. We pushed v2.0.6 with the patch yesterday. I'll attach image digest and CI job link. Triage timeline: detected 2026-03-16, patch built 2026-03-17, deployed to runners 2026-03-18.

zoe-sec: Good. Also prepare the signed non-exportable CMK statement (PDF signed with infra key). Keep ARNs redacted in the public bundle and offer full ARNs over secure channel.

harper-ops: I'll assemble artifacts: rbac-diff.csv (redacted), cedar-genkey.json (redacted ARNs), image-build.txt, signed-statement.pdf. Will tar, sign, then encrypt with their PGP key.

ben-eng: Action items: RBAC CSV (owner @ben-eng), KMS CloudTrail slice (owner @harper-ops), vuln artifacts + digest (owner @ivan-sre), signed stmt (owner @zoe-sec).

evidence-bot: notice: evidence-staging/3670012345 created at s3://redwood-sec/cedarcare/3670012345/ (internal)

ash-custsec: CedarCare requires SHA256 checksum and PGP envelope. I'll confirm SFTP credentials and PGP fingerprint and post here.

zoe-sec: ETA 4 hours. If legal needs to approve transfer POA, flag immediately.

ivan-sre: I'll post the image digest and CI link in 30m.

harper-ops: Starting cloudtrail export now.

ben-eng: Starting RBAC snapshot diff. Will update when CSV ready.

zoe-sec: Thanks team — keep updates in-thread and avoid sending full ARNs publicly. We'll treat extra asks as follow-ups after the call.
